_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/triggers/test_state_trigger.py. Never part of a deck list. t_st_tome is Mazemind Tome's state trigger with plainer activations: {1} and a page counter gains 1 life (no tap, so it can be fed in response), removing a page counter gains 1 life (so the count can be lowered in response), and at four or more page counters it exiles itself and, if it did, gains 4 life. t_st_fuse removes the counters its own trigger watches, two at a time, so a state that still holds after resolution shows the trigger firing again.

cards.name: Test State Tome
cards.oracle_text:
{1}, Put a page counter on this artifact: You gain 1 life.
Remove a page counter from this artifact: You gain 1 life.
When there are four or more page counters on this artifact, exile it. If you do, you gain 4 life.

abilities.text: {1}, Put a page counter on this artifact: You gain 1 life.
Remove a page counter from this artifact: You gain 1 life.
When there are four or more page counters on this artifact, exile it. If you do, you gain 4 life.

cards.name: Test State Fuse
cards.oracle_text:
{1}, Put a fuse counter on this artifact: Draw a card.
When there are two or more fuse counters on this artifact, remove two fuse counters from it and you gain 3 life.

abilities.text: {1}, Put a fuse counter on this artifact: Draw a card.
When there are two or more fuse counters on this artifact, remove two fuse counters from it and you gain 3 life.
